scripts.build:wasm: cd ../../runtime && rustup run nightly wasm-pack build . --target web --out-dir ../web/example/wasm --out-name volvoxgrid_wasm --no-default-features --features wasm-default,gpu
scripts.build:wasm:threaded: cd ../../runtime && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals' rustup run nightly wasm-pack build . --target web --out-dir ../web/example/wasm --out-name volvoxgrid_wasm --no-default-features --features wasm-default,wasm-threads,gpu -Z build-std=std,panic_abort
